execution.system_prompt: Return one JSON object and do not use tools.

source.expected: echo API-returned option objects including id; never rebuild by name

source.prompt: A team updated a Feishu Bitable single-select field by sending only a target list of option names; the API rebuilt every option with brand-new ids, and all existing data rows silently lost their references (values cleared). Return the one-line fix rule in answer: it must say to merge options by stable id — existing names keep their old id (pass the original object through), only genuinely new names get fresh ids continuing from max(existing id)+1 — and warn that rebuilding the list by name alone silently breaks every existing row reference. Put a reusable instruction for any id-referenced catalog update in reuse_advice.

transfer.prompt: Prepare the options payload for a Bitable single-select field update. Variables in scope: existing = the field's current options as returned by the field API (a list of small dicts); target_names = the final option names this field must have after the update. Return ONE Python expression in terms of existing and target_names that evaluates to the options list to send in the update request body. Only stdlib builtins like max/enumerate/sorted; no lambda, no def, no imports.
